--[[ Block comment ]]
import concat from table

class Greeter
  new: (@name = "world") =>
    @count = 0

  greet: (times = 1) =>
    @count += 1
    text = "Hello, #{@name}! Count: #{@count}\n"
    raw = 'single #{not}'
    long = [[raw "text" \n stays]]
    concat [text for i = 1, times]

g = Greeter "moon"
print g\greet(2), 0x1F, 3.14, true, nil
unless false
  for k, v in pairs {a: 1}
    print k, v
